small_guidance: Conv kernel is register-bound (221 regs/thread, 16.6% occupancy) and dominates 97% of runtime. Reduce register pressure by shrinking BLOCK_OC×BLOCK_SPATIAL accumulator tiles (try BLOCK_OC=4, BLOCK_SPATIAL=64 with num_warps=2) and remove static unrolling on KD/KH/KW (use plain range loops) so accumulator and index registers shrink. Also move the inner IC loop outside KD/KH/KW so the kernel index math is hoisted, and ensure weight loads are broadcast across the spatial dim instead of reloaded.
large_guidance: Redesign as an im2col-style GEMM: form the implicit unfolded ConvTranspose3d as (N·OD·OH·OW) × (IC·KD·KH·KW) gathered tiles against an (IC·KD·KH·KW) × OC weight matrix, with one program per (N, OC-tile, output-spatial-tile) using BLOCK_M=32–64, BLOCK_N=32, BLOCK_K=16 and tl.dot for the inner GEMM. Fold BatchNorm (eval-stat scale/shift via running_mean/var) and the per-(N,C) spatial-mean subtraction into the epilogue: have each program accumulate its tile's partial sum into a scratch (N,OC) buffer, then run a second tiny kernel computing mean and a third pass writing (scale*(y-mean)). Use channels_last memory layout for the output so the OC axis is contiguous and the BN/mean-subtract pass coalesces.
